metadata.simulationScope: Real geographic demonstration only. Trucks, cargo, disruptions, speed impacts and decisions are SIMULATED. This is not a validated freight or legal routing dataset. No joins to overseas historical operational cohorts.
metadata.speedAssumptionProvenance: SIMULATION_ASSUMPTION: scenario baseline speeds, not observed speeds or asserted legal limits
metadata.topology: Real OSM shared node IDs only; no invented intersections or coordinate-based merging
metadata.restrictionPolicy: Node-via restrictions retained; unsupported conditional/via-way restrictions exclude all participating ways
metadata.profile: Conservative simulated freight; private/restricted roads, unknown barriers and unmodelled weight/dimension limits excluded
metadata.boundaryPolicy: Only consecutive-node segments whose two real endpoints lie inside the requested bbox
metadata.componentPolicy: Largest strongly connected directed road component; turn restrictions also checked by route engine
